# P35.60 — Release classifier, standing go, readout generator (REL-06)

**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/337_P35.60__release-classifier-standing-go-readout.md`
(manifest row **337**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B). Invoked
`live_verification=false` — **machinery only**: the release classifier,
the standing-go validation, the agent-drafted readout generator, the
notice wiring, and the sign-off-scope ADR land; **no promotion was run,
no notification was sent, no standing go was adopted and no readout was
signed** — adoption and signing are the operator's recorded acts
(`D-P35.60-1`), never implied here. Stamps the owned ids:
**SIG-REL-012** (release classes and the standing go — Owner: P35.60)
and **SIG-CONF-010** (the readout's required wording and the notice
channel — Owner: P35.60; the P37.45 notice-surface extension stays an
`Also:`). Cited: **D-G3-3** (B-9 = a — the adopted standing-go form,
carried verbatim), **D-G3-1**, **ADR-154** (ratchet regression →
Class S), **SIG-REL-007** (the V14 deltas consumed — Owner: P35.58),
**SIG-SEC-010** (the machinery verifies a signature record, never
produces one), **SIG-ENG-042** (fail-closed — unevaluable → S),
**SIG-MEM-009** (authorship — no agent signs, silence is never
approval), **SIG-MEM-010** (records append-only). **Base:**
`r11/P35.59-dark-cutover-to-release-layout` (the branch the previous
row left checked out).

## What landed

- **`ops/src/ops/release_classify.py`** (new) — the §7.3 classifier and
  its companions. `classify` reads V14's emitted `deltas` and V15's
  `gate` evidence **verbatim** out of the `sig.release-results/1` suite
  docs — it never re-derives a measurement — plus declared release
  metadata, the journal, and the conf-generation history. Every R-column
  condition lands exactly one verdict row (`r` / `trigger` /
  `unevaluable`); **Class R requires an all-`r` ledger** — any trigger,
  any unevaluable input, any V14 anomaly → a named Class S. The R column
  is §7.3 verbatim: same code commit as an operator-signed release; same
  declared versions (ruleset/resolver/policy/projection/ontology/
  descriptor-schema); same public-surface routes (normalized so a
  pub-prefix is not a change); same compartments/licences/attribution/
  disclosures/evaluation status; sources same-or-fewer only through
  recorded withdrawals; V14 bounds −2 %…+15 % total / −5 %…+50 % per
  compartment / ≤ 20 % source share loss; V1–V14 green with zero
  waivers; `environment=production`; a scheduled/drift cut outside
  freezes. `evaluate_standing_go` validates the operator's adopted
  `sig.promotion-approval/1` `standing_go` — absent, expired, revoked,
  voided or out-of-scope each refuse; the in-flight rule honours an
  expired go once for a release classified while it was still valid;
  voiding is the append-only `sig.standing-go-void/1` marker the
  classifier writes itself on `ratchet-regression` / `new-source` /
  `part-viii-screen-change`. `draft_readout`/`write_readout` emit the
  §7.4-labelled **agent-drafted** pair under `registry/readouts/` —
  `signature` emitted **empty**, the required wording verbatim
  ("single maintainer, no second reviewer"; "no human check performed";
  the SIG-MEM-009 authorship sentence; the two explicit basis options).
  `notify_classification` records `release.readout-pending` /
  `release.classified` through the landed `alerts` seam — the operator's
  destination is environment-configured; **no address or secret is
  committed**.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_pipeline.py`** — `verb_classify` replaced the
  placeholder: suite load → `classify` → on `--apply` the
  `sig.release-classification/1` object (create-if-absent) + the
  `classified` journal event + go-void markers on voiding triggers +
  the Class-S readout draft + the notice record.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_conf.py`** — `check_approval` validates the
  standing-go condition set (adoption, expiry, revocation, the
  `.voided` marker, code-commit scope) and `verb_promote` reads the
  journal's class — a `--class` flag can never outvote it.
- **`exports/src/exports/release_fingerprint.py`** (new) + stamping in
  `release.py`/`site_release.py` — the deterministic template digest
  V14's `template_fingerprint` delta already reads.
- **`docs/adr/ADR-221-*.md`** — the sign-off-scope ADR ("what an
  operator signature means"), the SIG-REL-012 owner clause's deliverable;
  Appendix F row + regenerated spec and ADR index.
- **Coverage/deferral records** — SIG-REL-012 and SIG-CONF-010 →
  `MET-ENGINEERED(D-P35.60-1;D-R10-PUBLISH-1)` → BL-085;
  `D-P35.60-1` records the operator-adoption prerequisite.

## Tests

`tests/ops/test_release_classify.py` — **61 tests** covering the
contract's matrix verbatim: S on every unevaluable check and on a
ratchet-regression input (the catalog AC); every §7.1 bound breach → S;
every §7.2 trigger → S; an in-bounds diff → R; an
expired/void/out-of-scope standing go → refused; the generated readout
carries both required wordings verbatim, labelled agent draft, signature
slot empty; the no-readout set (`rollback`/`clear-latest`/`withdraw`)
still raises `go-required`; promote under a valid go applies, under an
expired or voided go refuses `approval-refused`.

## Out of scope (per contract)

Producing V14's deltas and the V15 signal → P35.58 (consumed here);
adopting the standing go or signing any readout → the operator
(`D-P35.60-1`); the P37.45 notice-surface extension → its own `Also:`
row; the mail/alert transport itself → the landed P34.4 channel this
row calls; the launch-exposure signature's own rules → P35.63's HG-11.
No live verification, no production mutation, no outside contact —
recorded as such.
